η3-splined curves can be generated with a closed form algorithm that is able to optimize the shape of the curve in real time, by minimizing the curvature variability.
(a) η3-spline is a planning primitive for wheeled mobile robot steering; (b) η3-splined can be used to plan optimal paths for wheeled mobile robotic steering.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel method for the online generation of smooth optimal curves for the automated steering.
the design of a new class of η3-spline curves, which can be used in the context of path generation for wheeled mobile robots.

the design and implementation of a new path planning primitive which, by means of a simple and computationally efficient algorithm, permits obtaining paths with a curvature variability as low as possible.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the η3-splined based method, which is here presented, can be used in order to generate optimal paths for wheeled mobile robot steering, in a way which is computationally effective, and at the same time, which permits to obtain a high degree of flexibility in the shape of the path itself.
the η3-spline is a powerful tool to be used in the generation of optimal trajectories for wheeled mobile robot.
the proposed method is a simple and effective tool to generate optimal η3-splined paths for wheeled mobile vehicles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method allows to generate optimal paths which are suitable to be used in online applications.
the proposed approach permits obtaining, in an efficient and easy way, optimal η3-spline paths for wheeled mobile robot steering.
the proposed method permits the online generation of optimal η3-curves for wheeled mobile robot steering.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by acting on the interpolating conditions, it is possible to generate η3-splined paths with optimal curvature variability, thus reducing the lateral forces acting on the robot.
, by means of the proposed method, it is possible to plan optimal trajectories for autonomous wheeled mobile robots in real time.

, by using the proposed approach, the path planner is able to generate optimal curves which are able to emulate, at the best, the shape of the optimal paths planned by using the optimization algorithms.
